Before I can approve the re-entry behavior and safety plan, I need to hear from each of you regarding any relevant observations, records, or family arrangements that might inform our planning. The draft plan currently includes ordinary cafeteria lunch, one weekly counselor check-in, the school's general emergency response, and an in-person family conference. I'd like to go through each component and hear your input. Who would like to start?
